Full body character illustration of a male sword cultivator in Chinese xianxia fantasy style. A young man in his mid-20s with sharp angular features, long black hair tied in a high ponytail with a jade hairpin, piercing ice-blue eyes. Wearing flowing white and pale blue daoist robes with silver cloud embroidery, a leather belt with a jade pendant, and arm bracers. Holding a glowing ethereal sword emitting pale blue spiritual energy, the blade inscribed with ancient runes. Standing on a cliff edge above a sea of clouds at sunset, wind blowing his robes dramatically. Aura of spiritual pressure visible as faint glowing particles around him. Dynamic pose with sword pointed downward, one foot slightly forward. Anime-influenced Chinese fantasy art style, detailed fabric physics, volumetric lighting, cinematic composition. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国玄幻仙侠风格的男性剑修。25岁左右青年，棱角分明的面容，黑色长发用玉簪束成高马尾，锐利的冰蓝色眼睛。身穿飘逸的白色和淡蓝色道袍，银色云纹刺绣，皮质腰带配玉佩，臂甲。手持一把散发淡蓝色灵气的发光飞剑，剑身刻有古老符文。站在日落时分的悬崖边缘，脚下是云海，风吹动道袍。灵压气场以微弱发光粒子形式可见。动态姿势，剑尖朝下，一脚微前倾。动漫风格中国奇幻艺术，精细布料物理效果，体积光，电影构图。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
仙侠小说男主，剑修角色立绘

Full body character illustration of a male alchemist cultivator in Chinese xianxia style. A scholarly man around 30 years old with gentle features, medium-length black hair partially tied, warm amber eyes behind round spectacles. Wearing layered earth-tone robes in brown, ochre and dark green with alchemical symbols embroidered on the sleeves, a sash with multiple small medicine pouches. One hand holding a glowing jade cauldron emitting golden vapor and swirling pill fragments, the other hand making a sealing gesture. Surrounded by floating medicinal herbs and golden spirit particles. Standing in an ancient alchemy chamber with stone shelves of medicine jars in the blurred background. Warm golden ambient light from the cauldron illuminating his face. Serene yet powerful expression. Chinese fantasy illustration, detailed textures, soft warm lighting. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的男性丹修。30岁左右书生气质男子，温和面容，黑色中长发半束，圆框眼镜后温暖的琥珀色眼睛。身穿层叠的大地色调道袍，棕色、赭石和深绿色，袖口绣有炼丹符文，腰带上挂着多个小药囊。一手持散发金色蒸汽和旋转丹碎片的发光玉鼎，另一手结印。周围漂浮着药草和金色灵气粒子。站在古老的炼丹室中，背景模糊可见石架上排列的药罐。鼎中温暖金色环境光照亮他的脸庞。宁静而强大的表情。中国奇幻插画，精细纹理，柔和暖光。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
仙侠丹修角色，炼丹师立绘

Full body character illustration of a male body cultivation cultivator in Chinese xianxia style. A muscular man in his late 20s with a rugged square jaw, short spiky black hair, fierce tiger-like golden eyes. Upper body exposed showing sculpted muscles with faint golden vein patterns glowing beneath the skin, wearing only loose dark brown pants and wrapped fists with bandages. A massive iron halberd planted in the ground beside him, crackling with earth-elemental energy. Standing in a volcanic wasteland with lava cracks glowing orange in the background, heat distortion visible. Power stance with arms crossed, golden aura emanating from his body forming a subtle tiger phantom behind him. Intense and domineering presence. Chinese dark fantasy art style, dynamic composition, dramatic rim lighting. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的男性体修。28岁左右肌肉发达男子，粗犷方形下颌，短刺黑发，凶猛虎形金色眼睛。上身赤裸展示雕塑般肌肉，皮肤下隐约可见金色经脉纹路发光，仅穿宽松深棕色裤子和缠绑布条的拳头。身旁插着一把巨大的铁戟，裂纹中闪烁土元素能量。站在火山荒原中，背景可见发橙光的岩浆裂缝，热浪扭曲可见。力量姿势双臂交叉，金色气场从身体散发，身后形成微妙的虎形幻影。强烈霸道的气场。中国暗黑奇幻艺术风格，动态构图，戏剧性边缘光。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
体修/武修角色，霸气风格

Full body character illustration of a female immortal fairy in Chinese xianxia style. A young woman with an ethereal beauty, porcelain skin, long flowing silver-white hair reaching her waist, luminous violet eyes with star-like reflections. Wearing a multi-layered celestial silk gown in white and lavender with lotus petal patterns, translucent sleeves revealing slender arms with a spirit bracelet, a golden coronet with dangling jade tassels. Floating gracefully above a lotus pond at night, moonlight reflecting off the water, surrounded by glowing fireflies and falling cherry blossom petals. One hand gently extended downward, fingertips emitting soft white light. Serene and otherworldly expression. Chinese high fantasy illustration, luminous lighting, dreamy atmosphere, detailed silk texture. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的女性仙子。年轻女子，超凡脱俗的美貌，瓷白肌肤，银白色长发飘逸至腰，发光的紫色眼睛带星光反射。身穿多层天丝仙裙，白色和薰衣草色，莲花花瓣纹样，半透明袖口露出纤细手臂和灵力手镯，金色凤冠垂挂玉穗。优雅地悬浮在夜晚的莲花池上方，月光倒映水面，周围环绕发光萤火虫和飘落的樱花花瓣。一只手轻柔向下伸出，指尖散发柔和白光。宁静超凡的表情。中国高端奇幻插画，发光照明，梦幻氛围，精细丝绸纹理。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
仙侠女主，仙子/神女立绘

Full body character illustration of a female demon cultivator in Chinese dark xianxia style. A seductive woman in her mid-20s with sharp features, long crimson hair with black streaks, one eye crimson and one eye gold (heterochromia), dark lipstick. Wearing a form-fitting black and deep red dress with spider web and skull motifs, a choker with a blood-red gem, long gloves, thigh-high boots with silver buckles. Holding a chain-connected twin scythe dripping with dark purple energy, the chains wrapped around one arm. Standing on a throne of black bones in a demon realm, purple and red lightning crackling in the dark sky behind her. Confident smirk, one hand on hip. Dark fantasy anime style, high contrast lighting, dramatic shadows, gothic Chinese fusion aesthetic. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国暗黑仙侠风格的女性魔修。25岁左右魅惑女子，锐利面容，深红色长发带黑色条纹，异色瞳（一只深红一只金色），深色唇膏。身穿贴身黑色和深红色连衣裙，蛛网和骷髅图案，血红宝石颈圈，长手套，银扣及膝靴。手持链式双镰刀，滴落暗紫色能量，链条缠绕一臂。站在魔界黑骨王座上，身后暗紫色和红色闪电在黑暗天空中劈裂。自信冷笑，一手叉腰。暗黑奇幻动漫风格，高对比度光线，戏剧性阴影，哥特中式融合美学。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
魔修/反派女主，暗黑风格

Full body character illustration of a holy maiden in Chinese xianxia style. A pure and dignified young woman with an oval face, long black hair styled in an elaborate updo with golden hairpins and pearl ornaments, gentle jade-green eyes. Wearing a ceremonial white and gold robe with phoenix and cloud patterns, a translucent golden veil over her lower face, multiple layered sashes in pale gold and white. Kneeling in a grand temple interior with incense smoke rising, golden Buddha light rays streaming through lattice windows, lotus flowers floating in the air around her. Hands clasped in prayer, a glowing lotus sigil floating above her palms. Serene and compassionate expression. Chinese religious fantasy art, warm golden lighting, sacred atmosphere, intricate architectural details. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的圣女。纯洁端庄的年轻女子，鹅蛋脸，黑色长发梳成精致发髻配金簪和珍珠饰品，温柔翠绿色眼睛。身穿仪式感白色和金色长袍，凤凰和云纹图案，下半脸覆半透明金色面纱，多层淡金色和白色飘带。跪在宏伟的寺庙内部，香烟袅袅升起，金色佛光透过花格窗照射，莲花在周围空气中漂浮。双手合十祈祷，掌心上方漂浮发光的莲花印记。宁静慈悲的表情。中国宗教奇幻艺术，温暖金色光线，神圣氛围，精致建筑细节。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。
圣女/神女角色，庄严风格

Full body character illustration of a supreme elder in Chinese xianxia style. An ancient man appearing 60 years old but with vitality, long white beard reaching his chest, thick white eyebrows, deep piercing eyes that seem to hold cosmic wisdom. Wearing elaborate multi-layered dark purple and gold robes with celestial dragon embroidery, a jade belt with a storage ring, a wooden staff topped with a glowing spirit stone. Floating in a cross-legged meditation pose above a mountain peak, surrounded by orbiting ancient runes and a massive protective array formation visible on the ground below. Long white hair and beard flowing upward due to spiritual energy. Aura of immense power creating distortion in the air around him. Chinese epic fantasy art, majestic atmosphere, dramatic top-down lighting, ultra-detailed. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.

全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的太上长老。看似60岁的古老男子但充满活力，白色长须及胸，浓密白眉，深邃锐利的眼神似乎蕴含宇宙智慧。身穿精致多层深紫色和金色道袍，天龙刺绣，玉带配储物戒，顶端镶嵌发光灵石的手杖。盘腿悬浮在山巅之上，周围环绕旋转的古老符文，下方地面可见巨大的护宗阵法。白色长发和长须因灵力向上飘动。强大气场在周围空气中产生扭曲。中国史诗奇幻艺术，庄严氛围，戏剧性顶光，超精细。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body character illustration of a demon king in Chinese xianxia style. A towering figure with a humanoid upper body but bull-like horns curving from his temples, long wild black hair, crimson eyes with vertical slit pupils, fangs visible. Torso covered in dark scaled armor with bone spikes, massive fur cape made from a nine-tailed fox pelt. Wielding an enormous black iron mace crackling with purple lightning. Standing atop a mountain of skulls in a dark nether realm, blood-red moon behind him, an army of shadow soldiers visible in the mist below. Dominating and terrifying presence, muscles bulging, ground cracking beneath his feet. Chinese dark fantasy illustration, imposing scale, dramatic backlighting, horror-fantasy fusion. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的妖王。高大身躯，人形上身但太阳穴处弯曲牛角，狂野黑色长发，红色竖瞳眼睛，可见獠牙。上身覆盖深色鳞甲配骨刺，九尾狐皮制成的巨大毛披风。挥舞一把闪烁紫色闪电的巨大黑铁锤。站在暗黑冥界的骷髅山上，身后血红色月亮，下方雾中可见暗影军队。威压恐怖的气场，肌肉隆起，脚下地面龟裂。中国暗黑奇幻插画，压迫性尺度，戏剧性逆光，恐怖奇幻融合。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body character illustration of a holy son of a cultivation sect in Chinese xianxia style. A handsome young man around 22 with an arrogant yet noble bearing, sharp jawline, golden-blond hair in a half-up warrior's knot, amber eyes with a vertical golden pupil. Wearing pristine white and gold sect robes with a sun crest on the back, a golden sash, white boots with gold trim. One hand holding a scripture scroll emitting golden light, the other hand forming a sword finger with a small golden sword of light at the fingertip. Standing at the entrance of a grand sect gate with disciples bowing in the background, golden sunlight breaking through clouds behind him. Confident and slightly aloof expression. Chinese cultivation novel illustration, bright and radiant aesthetic, clean lines. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
全身角色立绘，中国仙侠风格的宗门圣子。22岁左右英俊青年，傲慢而高贵的气质，锐利下颌线，金棕色头发束成半高武士髻，琥珀色眼睛带金色竖瞳。身穿洁白的金色宗门道袍，背部太阳纹章，金色腰带，白靴金边。一手持散发金光的经卷，另一手结剑指指尖有金色光剑。站在宏伟宗门入口处，背景弟子鞠躬，身后金色阳光穿透云层。自信略带冷漠的表情。中国修仙小说插画，明亮光辉美学，干净线条。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body illustration of a nine-tailed spirit fox in Chinese xianxia style. A magnificent fox the size of a horse with pristine white fur that glows with a soft blue luminescence, nine long flowing tails each tipped with a different colored flame (blue, white, gold, purple, green, red, cyan, silver, pink). Intelligent azure eyes with slit pupils, delicate fox features with ancient wisdom. Standing on a moonlit mountain peak, each tail trailing ethereal flame that forms constellation-like patterns in the night sky. Spiritual energy swirling around its paws creating frost patterns on the rock surface. Majestic and divine presence. Chinese mythological fantasy art, luminous effects, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fur texture. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
全身立绘，中国仙侠风格的九尾灵狐。马匹大小的华丽白狐，纯白皮毛散发柔和蓝色荧光，九条飘逸长尾各末端有不同颜色火焰（蓝、白、金、紫、绿、红、青、银、粉）。聪慧的蔚蓝色竖瞳眼睛，精致狐面蕴含古老智慧。站在月光下的山巅，每条尾巴拖曳空灵火焰在夜空中形成星座般的图案。灵力在爪周旋绕在岩石表面形成冰霜纹样。庄严神圣的气场。中国神话奇幻艺术，发光效果，空灵氛围，超精细毛发纹理。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body illustration of a five-clawed golden dragon in Chinese xianxia style. A massive imperial dragon with iridescent golden scales that shift between gold, amber and bronze, five razor-sharp claws on each limb, sinuous serpentine body coiling through clouds. Majestic dragon head with crown-like horns, flowing whiskers, and pearl-like eyes. Surrounded by swirling storm clouds, lightning crackling between scales, rainbows forming in the mist. Coiling around a celestial pagoda floating above a sea of clouds. Divine and awe-inspiring presence, every scale individually rendered. Chinese imperial dragon art, dynamic composition, dramatic atmospheric lighting, mythological epic quality. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
全身立绘，中国仙侠风格的五爪金龙。巨大的帝王龙，虹彩金色鳞片在金、琥珀和青铜色之间变化，每肢五把锋利利爪，蜿蜒蛇形身体盘旋穿行于云间。威严龙头配皇冠般龙角，飘逸龙须，珍珠般眼睛。环绕旋转的风暴云，鳞片间闪电劈裂，雾中形成彩虹。盘绕在云海之上漂浮的天阁周围。神圣令人敬畏的气场，每片鳞片单独渲染。中国帝王龙艺术，动态构图，戏剧性大气光线，神话史诗品质。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Create a grand cultivation sect hall interior in Chinese xianxia style. A vast circular main hall with towering jade pillars inscribed with glowing runes, a massive yin-yang symbol inlaid in the marble floor, a high throne-like seat at the far end on a raised platform. Floating lanterns casting warm golden light, incense smoke creating atmospheric haze, silk banners with sect crests hanging from the ceiling. Hundreds of kneeling disciples in white robes visible in the foreground. Beam of golden light descending from the dome ceiling onto the central platform. Epic scale, Chinese palace architecture meets fantasy, volumetric god rays, ultra-detailed architectural elements. No text, no watermark. 16:9 horizontal format.
创建一张中国仙侠风格的宏伟修仙宗门大殿内部。巨大的圆形主殿，高耸的玉柱刻有发光符文，大理石地面镶嵌巨大的阴阳图案，远端高台上的宝座式座椅。漂浮灯笼投射温暖金色光线，香烟营造大气薄雾，天花板上悬挂丝绸宗门旗帜。前景可见数百名穿白袍跪坐的弟子。金色光束从穹顶射向中央平台。史诗尺度，中国宫殿建筑融合奇幻，体积光束，超精细建筑元素。无文字，无水印。16:9横版。

Create a celestial immortal realm landscape in Chinese xianxia style. Floating islands connected by rainbow bridges, waterfalls flowing upward into the sky, crystalline palaces with glowing facades, peach blossom trees with golden leaves. A massive jade staircase ascending into clouds where a golden palace is partially visible. Celestial beings flying on swords and cranes in the distance. Ethereal golden and cyan color palette, soft diffused heavenly light, mist and cloud layers creating depth. Chinese celestial art meets high fantasy, dreamlike and transcendent atmosphere, ultra-wide composition. No text, no watermark. 16:9 horizontal format.
创建一张中国仙侠风格的天界仙境风景。浮空岛屿由彩虹桥连接，瀑布向上流入天空，水晶宫殿发光的立面，金叶桃花树。巨大的玉阶升入云端，金色宫殿若隐若现。远处仙人御剑和骑鹤飞行。空灵金色和青色调，柔和漫射天光，雾和云层创造深度。中国天界艺术融合高端奇幻，梦幻超脱氛围，超宽构图。无文字，无水印。16:9横版。

Create a detailed illustration of a cultivation flying sword in Chinese xianxia style. A slender elegant sword with a white jade blade that glows from within, the surface inscribed with ancient Daoist runes that pulse with blue light. The hilt is wrapped in white silk with a tassel of red threads and a small jade pendant. The sword floats at a diagonal angle, emitting a trail of blue spiritual energy particles, surrounded by faint wind currents visible as translucent swirls. Dark background with subtle mountain silhouettes. Clean product-shot style composition, dramatic rim lighting, ethereal glow effects. Chinese fantasy weapon art, 9:16 vertical format.
创建一张中国仙侠风格修仙飞剑的精细插图。纤细优雅的剑，白玉剑身从内部发光，表面刻有脉动蓝光的古老道符。剑柄缠绕白色丝绸，配红线流苏和小玉佩。剑以对角线角度悬浮，散发蓝色灵气粒子轨迹，周围可见半透明旋涡状的微弱气流。深色背景配微妙山峦剪影。干净产品照风格构图，戏剧性边缘光，空灵发光效果。中国奇幻武器艺术，9:16竖版。
法宝/武器立绘，道具设计

Create a detailed illustration of a mystical alchemy cauldron in Chinese xianxia style. A large three-legged bronze cauldron with intricate relief carvings of the four divine beasts (dragon, phoenix, tiger, tortoise) on its surface. The cauldron glows with internal golden fire, steam and golden pill fragments rising from the top. Ancient runes orbiting around it, the ground beneath cracked with golden light seeping through. Dark moody background with swirling alchemical symbols. Epic fantasy artifact illustration, dramatic warm lighting from the cauldron, detailed bronze texture and patina. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
创建一张中国仙侠风格神秘炼丹鼎的精细插图。大型三足青铜鼎，表面浮雕雕刻四神兽（龙、凤、虎、龟）。鼎内发光金色火焰，顶部升起蒸汽和金色丹碎片。古老符文环绕旋转，下方地面龟裂金色光芒渗出。暗色情绪背景配旋转炼丹符号。史诗奇幻神器插图，鼎部戏剧性暖光，精细青铜纹理和铜绿。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body character illustration of a wandering swordsman in Chinese wuxia style. A man in his late 20s with a weathered but handsome face, stubble, messy half-tied black hair, determined eyes. Wearing a worn dark blue changshan (traditional long gown) with a bamboo hat (douli) hanging on his back, a leather sword belt, cloth wraps on his forearms, straw sandals. Carrying a simple iron sword with a worn leather scabbard. Standing on an ancient stone bridge over a misty river at dawn, willow trees on the banks, a small village visible in the distance. Wind blowing his robes and hair. Melancholic yet resolute expression. Traditional Chinese ink-wash painting meets anime style, muted earth tones, soft morning light, atmospheric perspective. No text, no watermark. 9:16 vertical format.
全身角色立绘，中国武侠风格的游侠。28岁左右饱经风霜但英俊的面容，胡茬，凌乱半束黑发，坚定的眼神。穿深蓝色旧长衫，背上挂着竹笠，皮剑带，前臂缠布条，草鞋。携带一把朴素铁剑配磨损皮鞘。站在黎明时分雾河上的古石桥，岸边柳树，远处可见小村庄。风吹动他的衣袍和头发。忧郁但坚毅的表情。中国传统水墨画融合动漫风格，柔和大地色调，柔和晨光，大气透视。无文字，无水印。9:16竖版。

Full body character illustration of a master swordsman in Chinese wuxia style. A middle-aged man with a calm and weathered face, short neat black hair streaked with gray at temples, sharp observant eyes. Wearing a tailored black martial arts outfit with silver frog buttons, a dark red sash, black cloth boots, fingerless gloves.
